Extract MediaReferences from pulldown-cmark Image events
description: In the pulldown-cmark AST walker (from Phase 0), handle Tag::Image events to extract media references. When encountering Event::Start(Tag::Image(_, url, _)): 1. Create a MediaReference with source_path = url, target_name = filename component of url 2. Validate the target_name (reject illegal characters) 3. Add to the document media vec 4. The image event naturally produces in the card field text **Deduplication:** Collect into a HashSet or dedup after collecting so the same image referenced by multiple cards appears only once in ParsedDocument.media. **Tests:** - ![](image.jpg) -> answer — card front contains , media has one ref - question -> ![Alt](dir/image.png) — card answer contains , media ref has source_path="dir/image.png", target_name="image.png", alt_text=Some("Alt") - ![](a.jpg) <-> ![](b.jpg) — bidirectional card, two media refs - Two cards referencing same image — one media ref (deduped) - Nested context with image in child card - Card with no images — empty media vec, card works normally See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 1.2)

title: Convert Art.xls to Markdown format
description:
Create a Bun/TypeScript script to convert the existing Art.xls spreadsheet to the new Markdown card format.

**Setup:** bun add xlsx
**Usage:** bun convert_art.ts Art.xls > art-cards.md

**Input:** Art.xls
- Column 1: Image filename (e.g., pollice.jpg)
- Column 2: Title and Artist (newline separated)

**Output:** Markdown card file

**Format:**
```markdown
- ![](pollice.jpg) -> Pollice Verso by Jean-Leon Gerome
```

**Edge cases to handle:**
- Rows with no newline in the info field (missing artist)
- Missing data (use fallback values)
- Different image formats

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Migration section)

title: Add MediaReference type to doc-parser
description:
Add a new type to track image references discovered during parsing.

**File:** doc-parser/src/types.rs

Add MediaReference struct with:
- source_path: String (path as written in the Markdown, may include directories)
- target_name: String (just the filename component for Anki collection.media)
- alt_text: Option<String>

Update ParsedDocument to include media: Vec<MediaReference>

**Filename validation (at parse time):**
- target_name must NOT contain: [ ] " * : ? | \ or control characters
- Return ParseError if it does, pointing to the line and suggesting a rename
- source_path must not be empty

**Tests:**
- Unit test for MediaReference construction
- Test that ParsedDocument::default() has empty media vec
- Validation rejects image[1].jpg, file"name.png, img:2.jpg

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 1.1)

description:

title: Rewrite MarkdownParser::parse() using pulldown-cmark AST
description: Replace the line-based parser with a pulldown-cmark event walker. **File:** doc-parser/src/parser.rs pulldown-cmark v0.9 is already declared as a dependency but unused. The current parser is ~120 lines of manual line splitting. Rewrite to walk the pulldown-cmark event stream: 1. Track list nesting depth via Start(List)/End(List) and Start(Item)/End(Item) events 2. Within each list item, accumulate inline content (text, images, emphasis, etc.) 3. Scan accumulated text for -> or <-> arrow delimiters to split into question/answer 4. Extract raw text for each side (preserving inline formatting as-is) 5. Replace image syntax with tags 6. Non-leaf items (those containing sub-lists) become context parents **Key design point:** Arrow detection happens on the text content of a list item. Card fields remain as raw text (same as today), except that ![alt](path) image syntax gets replaced with tags. Existing text-only cards produce identical Card.fields and identical CardId hashes. **Tests (must pass all existing tests with identical output):** - test_basic_card — "One -> 1" → fields ["One -> ?", "1"] (unchanged) - test_bidirectional_card — "One <-> 1" → fields ["One <-> ?", "1"] (unchanged) - test_nested_context_list — parent context propagation (unchanged) **New tests:** - Arrow inside code span is NOT treated as delimiter - Inline formatting preserved as-is in fields See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 0.1)

title: Add card identity/hashing for tracking cards across syncs
Detect filename collisions across documents
description:
When syncing multiple documents, collect all MediaReferences and check for collisions: two different source_path values producing the same target_name.

Implement check_media_collisions():
- Group all refs by target_name
- If any target_name has multiple distinct source_paths, fail with a descriptive error listing both paths and suggesting a rename
- Same source_path from two documents is OK (dedup)

**Tests:**
- Same source_path from two documents — OK (dedup)
- Different source_paths, same target_name — hard error with both paths in message

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 2.2)
